decision.evidence: Medial compartment cartilage: Broad-based area of grade 4 chondrosis along the central the anterior weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle extending over 1.0 cm mediolateral dimension, and up to 1.9 cm anterior posterior dimension.
decision.reason: Broad grade 4 medial chondrosis spans explicitly 1.0 by 1.9 cm; highest-grade cartilage loss plus measured region supports threshold.

decision.evidence: The anterior horn medial meniscus is slightly extruded 3 mm beyond the tibial plateau. No medial meniscal tear is identified.
decision.reason: Slight medial extrusion with no tear diagnosis leaves whether morphology reaches target criterion unresolved.

decision.evidence: Focal fraying of the medial patellar facet articular cartilage is noted with mild underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.
